name: No Bull
verdict: Majority owned by US entrepreneur Mike Repole (family-office stake). Nothing found.
note: OKGC pillar partner 2026 (KFOR via Yahoo Sports, 2026-04-21; logo in OKGC team page partner grid). CNBC (2023-07-20) reported Repole's Impact Capital buying a majority stake in NOBULL; cnbc.com blocks scripts (403), so the checked source is SGB Media (2026-08-22), which reports Repole as majority owner and Tom Brady as second-largest shareholder after the 2024 TB12 merger. SGB says 'acquired in 2020'; CNBC's report dates the majority-stake purchase to July 2023 — flagged in the PR. Private US ownership; no state in the chain, nothing passes the METHOD.md test.
